  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
  • Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
  • Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
  • Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
  • Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
  • A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
  • Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
  • A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

  • We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
  • We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
  • We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â

description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

    Â

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

  • Develop new use cases with investigators and analysts that deepen usage across TRM products, including Ardence, and feed what you learn back into onboarding and enablement for the wider team

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at public sector agencies and regulators across EMEA — building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner

  • Partner with ADs, who own the commercial motion, to enable renewals and expansion: bring account health, adoption evidence, and a structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract, and take accountability for the GRR and NRR outcomes that adoption drives

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product — synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap

  • Work as one team with EMEA colleagues across languages and time zones, sharing the playbooks, workflows, and account plans that work so coverage is consistent across the region

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years in customer success, deployment, or post-sale roles with proven accountability for GRR, NRR, and adoption outcomes — you have the track record, not just the title

  • Domain credibility in law enforcement, public sector, cyber, national security, financial crime, or blockchain intelligence — you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you have worked in fast-changing product environments, can ship a working v1 without waiting for a perfect playbook, and can point to the specific outcomes it drove; Ardence is still evolving and your accounts may shift as it matures

  • Production AI fluency — you have built real, repeatable AI workflows (not just experiments) that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and have measurable results; you can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop

  • High level of independence — you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers

  • Strong executive presence — you can run a QBR with a senior government or public sector stakeholder and command the room through substance, not just polish

  • Based in the UK or Europe and comfortable working with customers across EMEA; additional European languages are a plus

About the Team:

  • The EMEA Public Sector team supports law enforcement, government, and regulatory customers working on complex cases involving crypto-related financial crime, cyber threats, and national security risks

  • You will join the EMEA Deployment Strategy team, which covers the region by geography and language (DACH and Eastern Europe, the UK, and SPLATAM), alongside Customer Experience. This is a net-new seat that adds coverage across our accounts, with high autonomy and meaningful influence on how we serve the region

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant — async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions

  • You will work directly with the Head of EMEA Deployment Strategy and the Head of Customer Success, with close day-to-day collaboration with the AD team and Product

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members may observe different timezones. However, most of the team will overlap between the hours of 7am-5:00 pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • Our Customer success Team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly Customer Syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with our customers. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • Moves fast and iterates — v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you have met every account in your portfolio and shipped a working onboarding and adoption plan for your first 2–3 accounts — not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction — getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook

  • Within 60 days, you identify the highest-impact use case or adoption play for your portfolio — presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on what to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

title: Ausbildung Kaufmann/-frau für Dialogmarketing (m/w/d) -Absofort-
description:
Inbound | Kundenkommunikation | Servicemanagement

Ausbildungsplatz | Standort Bochum

Zuhören. Verstehen. Koordinieren. Kunden spürbar weiterhelfen.

CareUnit Service GmbH betreut bundesweit gewerblich genutzte Kälte-, Klima- und Gebäudetechnik. Von Bochum aus koordinieren wir Kunden, Servicepartner und technische Einsätze. Dabei verbinden wir persönliche Kommunikation, kaufmännische Prozesse und moderne Serviceorganisation.

Warum diese Ausbildung zu uns passt

Wenn Kunden technische Unterstützung benötigen, zählt der erste Kontakt. In unserer Inbound-Kommunikation nimmst Du Anliegen auf, stellst die richtigen Fragen und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen zuverlässig weitergegeben werden. Dabei lernst Du nicht nur professionelle Gesprächsführung, sondern auch die kaufmännischen und organisatorischen Prozesse hinter gutem Kundenservice.

Das lernst Du bei uns

  • Du lernst, eingehende Kundenanfragen und Störmeldungen professionell telefonisch und schriftlich aufzunehmen

  • Du stellst gezielte Rückfragen, dokumentierst Informationen vollständig und ordnest Anliegen richtig ein

  • Du koordinierst gemeinsam mit dem Team Serviceeinsätze unserer bundesweiten Servicepartner

  • Du legst Serviceaufträge in unserer Unternehmenssoftware an, verfolgst Bearbeitungsstände und hältst Kunden informiert

  • Du lernst unterschiedliche Gesprächssituationen und einen verbindlichen Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Anliegen kennen

  • Du bearbeitest E-Mails, Rückmeldungen und Reklamationen kundenorientiert und lösungsbezogen

  • Du unterstützt bei Angeboten, Auftragsbearbeitung und Fakturierung

  • Du erhältst Einblicke in Qualitätsmanagement, Gesprächsauswertung und die Verbesserung von Serviceabläufen

  • Du lernst, auch bei mehreren parallelen Vorgängen Prioritäten zu setzen und zuverlässig zu kommunizieren

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens mittlerer Schulabschluss; auch Bewerbungen mit höherem Schulabschluss sind willkommen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Freude am telefonischen und schriftlichen Kundenkontakt

  • Klare, freundliche Ausdrucksweise und die Fähigkeit, aufmerksam zuzuhören

  • Interesse an technischen Themen und Bereitschaft, Zusammenhänge in Kälte-, Klima- und Servicetechnik zu lernen

  • Zuverlässigkeit, Pünktlichkeit und sorgfältige Dokumentation

  • Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und Offenheit für regelmäßiges Feedback

  • Teamfähigkeit und zugleich der Wunsch, schrittweise selbstständiger zu arbeiten

  • Ruhe, Respekt und Lösungsorientierung auch in anspruchsvolleren Gesprächssituationen

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

Was diesen Ausbildungsplatz besonders macht

  • Bei uns bedeutet Dialogmarketing Inbound, nicht Verkauf nach Skript und nicht wahlloses Telefonieren. Du arbeitest im Servicemanagement eines technischen Dienstleisters. Gespräche sind individuell, häufig zeitkritisch und müssen sauber dokumentiert sowie organisatorisch weitergeführt werden. Kommunikation und tatsächliche Fallbearbeitung gehören deshalb fest zusammen. sind von Vorteil; ein Führerschein Klasse B ist hilfreich, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Abwechslungsreiche und praxisnahe Ausbildung mit festen Ansprechpartnern

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und persönliche Begleitung während der Ausbildung

  • Ein Team, das Wissen teilt und Dich Schritt für Schritt an Verantwortung heranführt

  • Gute Übernahmechancen bei erfolgreichem Ausbildungsverlauf

  • Unterstützung bei Seminaren, Prüfungsvorbereitung und persönlicher Entwicklung

  • Übernahme Deines ÖPNV-Tickets

  • Gesundheitsfördernde Angebote über unser Programm CareHuman

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und Einblicke in ein bundesweit tätiges Serviceunternehmen

Ganz offen

Kundenkontakte sind nicht immer einfach. Manchmal fehlen Informationen, technische Lösungen dauern oder mehrere dringende Vorgänge treffen gleichzeitig ein. Du wirst dabei begleitet und lernst, ruhig, respektvoll und verbindlich zu bleiben. title: Senior Propulsion & Performance Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a Senior Propulsion & Performance Engineer to make our interceptor drones faster, more agile and more predictable. You will analyze aerodynamics, stability and performance, build the aerodynamic databases and flight dynamics models our GNC and simulation teams rely on, and size and test the propulsion systems that power our interceptors. You will move between analysis, the thrust stand and flight test data, and see your models turn into better aircraft within short iteration cycles.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Size and analyze the propulsion system, its aerodynamic, thermal and dynamic performance

  • Select and size propulsion components such as motors, propellers, ESCs, and batteries, or small turbojets and boosters

  • Optimize propeller and motor matching for high thrust, fast response, and efficiency across dash and loiter conditions

  • Analyze battery performance under high discharge rates, including voltage sag, thermal behavior, and usable capacity

  • Plan and run propulsion tests on thrust stands, and support wind tunnel testing where needed

  • Support aircraft design and performance analysis activities, e.g. conceptual design studies, stability and controllability analysis.

  • Support the GNC and Simulation teams in building and validating 6-DOF flight dynamics models

  • Analyze flight test data, use system identification to refine models, and feed results back into design

  • Document analyses, test results, and design data for internal teams and customers


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

  • Strong knowledge of aerodynamics, flight mechanics, and aircraft performance

  • Solid understanding of propulsion: jet engines, motors, propellers, ESCs, and lithium battery systems

  • Experience with aerodynamic tools such as XFLR5, AVL, OpenVSP, or similar

  • Experience with CFD (e.g., ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, or SU2)

  • Familiarity with propeller analysis tools such as XROTOR or QPROP

  • Programming skills in Python or MATLAB, and experience with Simulink

  • Hands-on experience with propulsion testing, thrust stands, and data acquisition

  • Experience analyzing flight test data and log files

  • Analytical mindset and the ability to judge which fidelity level a question actually needs

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced startup or defense environment with short iteration cycles

  • Eligibility for national security clearance, and possibly EU or national citizenship

Nice to have

  • Experience with small UAVs, high-performance drones, FPV racing drones, or loitering munitions

  • Knowledge of high-speed aerodynamics or small gas turbine and rocket propulsion

  • Experience with system identification methods

  • Experience with wind tunnel testing

  • Background in defense projects or military standards

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective.

By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Your mission

  • Conceptualization & Expansion of Energy Market Solutions: Development and operational establishment of scalable models for balancing group management (BKM), direct marketing, and flexibility optimization for our C&I and enterprise customers with multi-site portfolios
  • Tech & Market interface: Close collaboration with our software and product teams to further develop our virtual power plant (Heartbeat AI Enterprise) – defining functional requirements for aggregation, dynamic flexibility bands, and schedule setpoints
  • Partner & Trading Management: Selection, integration, and ongoing management of external BKM and trading partners (e.g., algorithmic intraday trading companies, aggregators, transmission system operators)

  • Risk & Schedule Management: Monitoring forecasting quality, balancing energy costs (reBAP), and schedule notifications to minimize financial risks in the balancing group
  • Regulatory Framing: Ensuring and implementing relevant energy industry regulations (e.g., mixed storage guidelines / MiSpeL, MaBiS, Redispatch 2.0) in customer contracts and system workflows

Your profile

  • Completed degree in energy economics, industrial engineering, electrical engineering, business administration, or a comparable qualification
  • Several years of professional experience in balancing group management (BKM), at a direct marketer, flexibility aggregator (VPP), or in short-term power trading (EPEX SPOT Day-Ahead / Intraday)
  • Sound understanding of the deployment and monetization of large-scale and commercial battery energy storage systems (BESS) as well as PV systems in the C&I segment
  • Solid knowledge of the German regulatory framework (StromNEV, EnWG, MaBiS, MiSpeL) and market communication processes
  • High affinity for software, IoT architectures, and API-driven data flows between edge gateways, VPP platforms, and trading systems
  • Strong analytical mindset, entrepreneurial drive, and structured problem-solving skills
  • Persuasive communicator at eye level with enterprise customers and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
  • Business fluent in German and English, both spoken and written

Benefits

You will join Flix's People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a technically hands-on Business Analyst, bridging HR operations, Workday and emerging AI and automation technologies.

You will understand how HR processes work end to end, identify opportunities to simplify and automate them, and turn business challenges into practical technology solutions.

Beyond gathering requirements, you will help build and deploy workflows, integrations and AI-enabled tools, while supporting Workday tech operations and process optimization in close collaboration with our internal Workday technology team and FlixTech.

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and collaborates with HR process owners, People Operations, Workday Tech team, FlixTech, IT Security and Data Privacy teams globally. 

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Analyze and optimize HR processes across the hire-to-retire lifecycle, working with People Operations and process owners to identify inefficiencies, conduct as-is/to-be gap analyses and translate requirements into practical Workday, automation and AI solutions
  • Support hands-on Workday operations and optimization, including approved HRIS transactions, organizational and position management, data maintenance, EIB uploads and functional testing, working within established security and governance frameworks
  • Design, build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, UiPath, Python and GenAI/LLM technologies, including MCPs, custom connectors, exception handling, monitoring and operational support.
  • Build and deploy AI-powered HR tools and internal applications, including Claude-based apps, with appropriate authentication, role-based access, data privacy and governance in collaboration with FlixTech and IT Security.
  • Drive business analysis and technical delivery from requirements and process design through prototyping, integration specifications, SIT/UAT, implementation and adoption, collaborating with Workday tech team on Workday configuration and technical integrations
  • Develop HR technology products and service-delivery solutions using Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo Agents, improving employee and HR experiences through workflow automation, self-service and continuous product improvement

Most HR analyst roles stop at scoping requirements and handing them over. This one doesn't. You will keep Workday running for HR day to day, shape how our processes work in Workday, and build the automation and AI that removes manual work. You'll be the person the People function brings its problems to, and you'll help define how AI & Automation is adopted responsibly across HR at scale. 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in HR technology, HR business analysis, HRIS or automation, with strong operational HR domain knowledge across the hire-to-retire lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of Workday Core HCM, business processes, organizational structures, security concepts and HRIS governance, including practical experience with Workday optimization, operational transactions, reporting, data maintenance or EIBs. A Workday (e.g. Core HCM) certification is preferred
  • Strong business analysis skills: gap analysis between as-is Workday processes and feasible to-be processes, requirements engineering, BPMN, and the ability to explain clearly to both HR and technical colleagues what is possible and what is not
  • Strong hands-on programming and automation experience, particularly Python, n8n, UiPath or comparable tools, with proven experience building, troubleshooting and maintaining production workflows. N8n certification is a strong plus
  • A solid understanding of various integration approaches e.g. APIs, custom connectors and enterprise integrations, including REST APIs, SFTP, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, to specify integration requirements for tech teams to ensure secure data exchange between HRIS and other enterprise systems
  • Hands-on knowledge of the Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence and Rovo agents, together with experience building AI-enabled tools using Claude MCP, GenAI/LLMs or similar technologies and applying appropriate security controls
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work independently across HR and technology teams

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
  • Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
  • A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
  • Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
  • The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
  • A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

Next steps

What to expect from our hiring process:

  1. Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.
  2. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.
  3. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.
  4. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

A strong, current backend engineer.

Experienced with the JVM ecosystem.

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

  • Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

  • Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

  • Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

  • Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

  • Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

  • High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

  • FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

  • Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

  • Network protocols (Ethernet).

  • Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

  • HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

  • Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

description:
Company overview

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.

Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we're working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

The role

Laboratories are digitising fast, and demand for our diagnostic AI has outgrown the way we deliver it. Every new lab is a project with many moving parts: our software is connected to the lab's image management and information systems, our AI is calibrated and validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each project brings together lab directors, pathologists and IT on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally. Usually several of these projects run at the same time and compete for the same people.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you own the delivery of these projects, from signed contract to routine clinical use. You set the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, make the trade-offs when projects compete, and carry the go-live date. From day one you own around 10 lab customers in parallel, from smaller labs to important accounts, without needing someone to tell you what to do next.

This is a senior delivery role. We are looking for someone who has done this before and can take ownership quickly, not someone who will learn project execution on the job. It is not a sales role and carries no sales target.

What you'll own

Delivery of our lab implementations

  • Own each implementation end to end: plan, milestones, dependencies, risks and the committed go-live date.

  • Run several implementations in parallel. Sequence them, decide what moves first when they compete for ML, engineering or customer time, and escalate only what you cannot resolve.

  • Drive technical integration with the lab and its partners (IMS, LIS, scanners, network and security reviews), working directly with our engineers and the customer's IT.

  • Direct the work of our product, ML, engineering and quality teams and of the customer's staff. Get firm commitments, follow them up, and don't accept "not possible right now" without a plan.

  • Accompany the validation each lab runs before go-live. The lab's medical director designs the study; you make sure the setup works, our teams deliver what the validation depends on, and the lab has everything it needs to finish.

  • Raise risks early, with options and a recommendation, rather than after a date slips.

The customer relationship through go-live and beyond

  • Be the lab's main operational contact: run the regular project calls, send the recaps, keep every open item owned and dated on both sides.

  • After go-live, own support for your labs: monitor usage, resolve what you can, coordinate product and engineering on the rest, and close the loop.

  • Bring structured customer feedback into product planning, and flag expansion opportunities to Sales.

How we deliver

  • Use and improve our delivery playbook, tracking and tooling so each implementation is faster and more predictable than the last.

What success looks like after six months

  • You run our small and mid-size lab implementations independently, with the Head of Diagnostic Products informed but no longer in the day-to-day.

  • Several onboardings run in parallel to plan, with fewer surprises close to deadlines.

  • Customers have one competent contact; our internal teams get clear, prioritised requests instead of ad-hoc escalations.

  • You are taking over parts of our larger, more product-heavy accounts.

Your profile

  • At least 2–3 years delivering projects to external customers, with several clients in parallel and at least one project owned from kickoff to go-live: clinical or diagnostic software, digital pathology, laboratory or medical device rollout, health IT, or comparable B2B delivery.

  • A track record of hitting committed dates in projects with dependencies you did not control. You can describe a project that went wrong and what you did about it.

  • A degree in a life or natural science such as biology, medicine, chemistry or physics, or several years of work in a comparable scientific field. You speak credibly with pathologists and can judge whether a pragmatic shortcut still makes scientific sense.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication. You lead conversations with lab directors, pathologists and IT teams, get commitments from people you don't manage, and raise blockers early. You work credibly with developers: you understand how they work and can challenge their estimates. You don't need to code.

  • Organised and self-driven: you keep many commitments on track without reminders, work in our delivery tools and help improve them, need no hand-holding, and know when "good enough" is the right call.

Nice to have

  • German language skills; experience in pathology, diagnostics or laboratory environments.

  • Experience delivering software into a regulated clinical setting or working within a quality management system.

What Mindpeak offers

description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Join our LCA team as a Working Student (10-20 h/week) and support the work that sits underneath every Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) we produce. Your focus will be raw material matching, the backbone of every EPD and LCA. You will work with the ecoinvent database and our Emidat Ecomapping tool, and research LCA topics such as product category rule (PCR) requirements. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting the day-to-day LCA team, who are responsible for the correct calculation of LCA results in the Emidat App.
