title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
description:
Founding Engineer


Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply

Apply with the button on this page.

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

  1. Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

  2. Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

  3. Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

  4. Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

  5. References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation: €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location: Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

title: Softwaretester / QA Engineer als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
description:
Mach aus guten Ideen Software, die im Alltag überzeugt

Du probierst neue Funktionen aus und merkst schnell, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft? Du willst Fehler verstehen, Lösungen mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team ein Produkt besser machen? Dann könnte das deine Rolle bei AUGLETICS sein.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren smarte Rudergeräte in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Bei uns siehst du direkt, wie deine Arbeit das Training unserer Kunden verbessert: Du testest am echten Gerät, arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung zusammen und begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Release.

Du ergänzt unser Softwareteam mit vier bis fünf Personen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Dein Schwerpunkt ist Softwarequalität. Dazu übernimmst du technische Projektkoordination: Du bringst Ordnung in offene Aufgaben, klärst Anforderungen und hilfst dem Team, Ideen zuverlässig umzusetzen. In diese Verantwortung kannst du hineinwachsen.

Das machst du bei uns

  • App und Gerät gründlich testen: Du prüfst neue Funktionen, typische Trainingsabläufe und Grenzfälle und gibst konkretes Feedback zu Funktion und Bedienbarkeit.

  • Tests aufbauen und verbessern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, Checklisten und wiederholbare Regressionstests. Schritt für Schritt baust du Testautomatisierung auf – immer dort, wo sie dem Produkt und dem Team hilft.

  • Fehler bis zur Lösung verfolgen: Du beschreibst reproduzierbare Schritte, grenzt Ursachen gemeinsam mit der Entwicklung ein und prüfst, ob eine Korrektur auch im Zusammenspiel mit anderen Funktionen funktioniert.

  • Projekte ins Ziel bringen: Du strukturierst Aufgaben, formulierst klare Abnahmekriterien, koordinierst Abhängigkeiten und machst Fortschritt und offene Fragen sichtbar.

  • Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Du moderierst agile Abstimmungen, etwa aus Scrum oder Kanban, und hilfst, Hindernisse zu beseitigen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team entwickelst du Abläufe weiter, die zu uns passen.

  • KI praktisch nutzen: Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Testideen, Fehleranalyse, kleine Hilfsprogramme und Automatisierung ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Interesse an Softwaretests, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Projekten. Erste Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung – auch ein eigener Lernweg oder die Motivation, dich neu in das Thema einzuarbeiten, interessieren uns.

  • Freude daran, genau hinzuschauen und Probleme systematisch zu lösen. Du kannst verständlich erklären, was nicht funktioniert und wie es sich nachstellen lässt.

  • Technisches Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von App, Gerät und Backend sowie Lust, dich tiefer einzuarbeiten.

  • Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du fragst nach, hältst offene Punkte nach und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte Entwicklung und Tests. Wenn du damit schon selbst experimentiert hast, zeig uns gern ein Beispiel.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um technische Themen im Team sicher zu besprechen und zu dokumentieren. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen zu arbeiten: Viele Tests finden direkt am Rudergerät statt.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Android-Entwicklung, zum Beispiel mit Kotlin oder Java.

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps und dem Zusammenspiel von App, Benutzerkonten und gespeicherten Daten.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Erste Kenntnisse in Testautomatisierung, Git, CI/CD oder agiler Projektarbeit. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du anfassen und ausprobieren kannst, und viele Ideen, die wir gemeinsam in hoher Qualität umsetzen wollen.

  • Ein Team von rund 25 Mitarbeitenden, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Raum, fachlich zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung für Qualität, Tests und Projektabläufe zu übernehmen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Beispielprojekt oder ein Testkonzept ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. The role focuses on hands-on software testing and quality assurance, with growing responsibility for project coordination. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

title: Android Developer with Scrum Master Responsibilities (m/f/d)
description:
Build Android software that gets people moving

Want to develop Android apps and see your code become part of a real product? At AUGLETICS, you will work on software for our connected rowing machines and our app. You can try out new features on the equipment and improve them with the team, from an early prototype to a reliable experience for our customers.

We develop and manufacture in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin. Our company has around 25 people. You will join a software team of four to five and work directly with our CTO, Christopher Klabunde. We have plenty of ideas and are looking for someone who enjoys building things, thinks for themselves and cares about quality.

What you will work on

  • Android development: Build new features for our device software and app, improve existing workflows and create an intuitive, reliable user experience.

  • Connected systems: Work on interfaces between the app, device software and backend, helping make data flows and error handling reliable.

  • Hands-on prototyping: Turn ideas into working prototypes, try them on our rowing machines and develop promising approaches with the team.

  • Quality from the start: Write understandable, maintainable code, take part in reviews and tests, and fix problems thoroughly.

  • AI-assisted development: Use AI tools for ideas, coding, testing and debugging. Understand and verify their output before it becomes part of the product.

Your role as Scrum Master

Alongside your technical work, you will help our projects move forward as a team. As Scrum Master, you will coordinate collaboration within our software team and with external development agencies, working closely with CTO Christopher Klabunde. This role does not include line-management responsibility.

  • Bring internal developers and external partners into a shared plan, with clear responsibilities, next steps and acceptance criteria.

  • Prepare and facilitate agile discussions, such as sprint planning, short daily check-ins, reviews and retrospectives, adapted to the needs of our projects.

  • Track dependencies, milestones and open decisions, raise obstacles early and help the team resolve them.

  • Help bring everyone’s work together so it can be tested as a complete product and prepared for reliable releases.

If you already have Scrum Master or project coordination experience, bring it with you. If you are new to the role, Chris and the team will support you as you grow into it. A Scrum Master certification is welcome, but not required.

What you bring

  • Programming fundamentals and an interest in native Android development with Kotlin or Java. Android experience is welcome; if you are new to it, tell us how you learn and why it interests you.

  • The ability to explain how you approach a technical problem. Personal apps, learning projects, university work, internships and student jobs all count alongside professional experience.

  • An interest in writing reliable, maintainable software and learning how to test it well.

  • Openness to AI-assisted app development and a willingness to question and check the results.

  • Initiative, a collaborative approach and the desire to learn an existing product and gradually take ownership.

  • Good spoken and written English is required. You need to discuss technical topics confidently with the team. German is not required, but it is a strong advantage.

  • The ability to work regularly on site in Königs Wusterhausen, where we develop and test directly on the devices.

A degree in computer science or a related subject, relevant vocational training, or equivalent knowledge provides a good foundation.

Experienced or just starting out? We would like to meet you

Already have several years of experience? Great – bring your ideas and a fresh perspective. New to this field or looking for your first professional role? That is welcome too. If you are excited about our product, have a technical foundation and learn quickly, we would like to hear from you.

Whichever stage you are at, it is our job to help you settle into the team and provide the knowledge, tools and support you need to succeed. You will get to know our product and ways of working alongside Chris and the team. We will match your initial tasks and responsibilities to your experience and help you grow from there.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Firebase as an app backend, for example user authentication, data storage or server-side logic.

  • Experience in iOS development, ideally with Swift or SwiftUI.

  • Knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, API integration or connecting software to devices.

What we offer

  • A real product you can try out yourself, with a direct impact on how our customers train.

  • A company of around 25 people, a small software team and close collaboration with CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Room for your ideas and professional growth, with responsibilities that develop with your skills.

  • A permanent, full-time position: 40 hours per week and 28 days of annual leave.

  • €50,000–€65,000 gross per year, depending on your relevant skills and experience.

  • A workplace in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one or two days of working from home per week by agreement.

Working near Berlin

Our office is at Zur Heide 10, Königs Wusterhausen. The town has direct S46 S-Bahn and regional train connections to Berlin; you can cycle from the station to our office. Regular on-site work matters because development, testing and teamwork happen around the actual rowing machines. This is a hybrid role based in Germany.

How to apply

Send us your CV in English or German. No formal cover letter is needed. A GitHub link or an app you have worked on is welcome, but optional.

We will start with a short online conversation, followed by a closer look at your experience, learning approach and the work at AUGLETICS.

title: (Senior) Enterprise Engagement Manager (f/m/d)
description:
About Stackgini

How do you govern 20,000 applications when nobody in the building still knows which of them do the same thing? How do you get faster to market and leaner at the same time, when business units ship AI prototypes in days and the regulatory load grows every quarter?

Stackgini is the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. Our system understands our customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up: from technical configuration to application documentation, from a single tech demand to the dependencies across the entire portfolio. With the depth of knowledge of a senior tech expert and the speed of a machine. Some of the largest organizations in the world work with us, including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers and REWE.

We're a small, talent-dense team, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

About the role

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you own what Stackgini actually becomes inside our customers. You take over once the deal closes and guide the organization from the first target-picture discussion to the point where tech demand management runs differently than it did before.

This is advisory work with a product behind it. You sit with CIOs, IT business partners, and enterprise architects, understand how their demand process works today and where it breaks, and design a target picture they can defend internally. You measure what it delivered and turn that into the basis for the next year.

Unlike consulting, you don't walk out after the final presentation. You stay with the accounts you own and see, over years, what became of your work.

Areas of ownership

  • Strategic advisory. You are the trusted advisor to tech leaders in DAX-40, Fortune-500, and ambitious mid-market organizations. You show them what best-practice AI-first demand management looks like and bring an outside view they can't get internally. Out of that you develop the target picture with them, from the end-to-end process concept to how Stackgini fits into the existing IT toolchain.

  • Value realization. You define the KPIs you will be measured against together with the customer, baseline them, and prove the effect. You guide them through portfolio optimization and build the business cases behind it. Realized value is not a story for the QBR here, it is the number the role hangs on.

  • Stakeholder engagement. You make the champions inside the customer's organization successful. You give them the arguments, the evidence, and the backing they need to carry Stackgini into business units, IT governance, architecture, procurement, and information security.

  • Adoption and enablement. You make power users and multipliers capable through trainings, best practices, and workshops, and you feed what you learn back into our methodology.

  • Account growth and expansion. Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and units, and spot risk before it surfaces in a renewal.

  • Build our customer value engine. You work hands-on on daily operations, expand the Stackgini Academy into a best-in-class enablement hub, and develop thought leadership assets: playbooks, point-of-view content, best practice guides.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Bring structured customer insights into Product and Engineering, shape our roadmap with use-case-driven evidence, and support Sales on key strategic deals.

Who you are

  • 2+ years in enterprise tech or consulting. Strategy or management consulting, IT transformation, or an enterprise tech function such as IT governance, architecture, or tech demand management. What matters is that you owned an outcome at a customer, not a workstream.

  • You structure ambiguity. You break down complex problems, shape them into clear options, and build processes that work without you.

  • You hold your own up to C-level. Precise in writing, structured in speech, composed in front of executives. In German and English.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You can describe concretely how you use LLMs, agents, or custom workflows in your daily work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be credible in a room with one.

  • Ownership over scope. You move things forward without waiting to be assigned, and client-facing work energizes you rather than drains you.

What's a plus

  • A real understanding of how enterprise tech organizations work, ideally with exposure to enterprise architecture, IT governance, software asset management, or IT procurement

  • Experience designing onboarding paths, trainings, and certifications that drive adoption at scale

Your first 90 days

We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system starts from what a customer already has: knowledge base articles, support conversations, tickets, system logs, and agent traces. From that evidence it reverse-engineers how the business actually runs and writes the process down as instructions a person can inspect and an agent can execute, with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input.

We're looking for AI Research Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You'll work on our agentic learning environment: the loops that turn human corrections and agent outcomes into better knowledge and instructions over time. The job combines applied research with ownership of production systems. You find a failure, form a hypothesis, run the experiment, and ship the fix into real customer workflows.

You'll spend most of your time advancing our core context-learning library and the harness that powers our agents across every customer. The work spans continuous learning, context engineering, agent orchestration, and evaluation. You'll contribute to our knowledge benchmarks and to the self-improving capabilities of the harness.


What You'll Do

  • Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities.

  • Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production.

  • Build agentic features for knowledge management: agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously.

  • Build continuous learning loops that use human corrections and production outcomes to find knowledge gaps, detect changed procedures, and improve prompts and instructions.

  • Build reliability and confidence systems: evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate and when to escalate to a human.

  • Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration.

  • Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities.


What We’re Looking For

  • You've built a complex, production LLM system with real depth: multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through, including what changed after real users arrived.

  • You have practical depth in one or more of context engineering, retrieval, agent orchestration, memory, evaluation, or learning from feedback.

  • You have experimental judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a testable hypothesis, set a baseline, and tell a real improvement from noise.

  • You're excited by open-ended problems where the solution might not exist yet.

  • You can navigate between research papers and production code with equal comfort.

  • You're a strong communicator who can explain your work to teammates and customers.

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience.

 

Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

Responsibilities

Functional and system testing

  • Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

  • Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations.

  • Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports.

  • Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health.

  • Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing.

Verification tracking

  • Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design.

  • Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign.

  • Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones.

  • Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance.

GSE and test infrastructure

  • Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes.

  • Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor.

  • Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware.

Integration and campaign support

  • Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures.

  • Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign.

  • Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing.

  • Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions.

Requirements

  • Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.

  • Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems.

  • Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components.

  • Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, ADCS, communications (TT&C and payload RF), propulsion, thermal, structures and payloads.

  • Experience using and setting up GSE, including EGSE, checkout systems and RF test equipment.

  • Experience with requirements verification and maintaining a verification matrix through to close-out.

  • Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, spectrum analysers, logic analysers.

  • Familiarity with common spacecraft interfaces and protocols (e.g. CAN, I2C, SPI, RS-422, SpaceWire, CCSDS).

  • Clear technical writing for procedures, test reports and NCRs.

Desirables

  • End-to-end involvement in at least one satellite mission that reached launch.

  • Test automation and scripting in Python or similar, and experience with spacecraft control or checkout software (e.g. OpenC3/COSMOS, Yamcs, SCOS-2000).

  • Experience planning or supporting environmental test campaigns (vibration, TVAC, EMC).

  • Knowledge of ECSS standards (e.g. ECSS-E-ST-10-02 Verification, ECSS-E-ST-10-03 Testing) or NASA equivalents.

  • Requirements management tools (e.g. DOORS, Jama, Polarion, Valispace).

  • Launch campaign experience at a launch site.

  • Cleanroom and ESD-certified flight hardware handling.

  • Eligibility for UK security clearance, or the ability to obtain it, if required by the programme.

Personal attributes

  • Takes ownership: drives tests and verification to close-out without waiting to be asked.

  • Methodical and detail-focused, with a strong sense of safety and quality around flight hardware.

  • Calm, structured problem-solver when anomalies appear under schedule pressure.

  • Communicates clearly across disciplines, from subsystem engineers to programme managers and customers.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced SmallSat environment, balancing rigour with pace.

  • Willing to work flexibly during test and launch campaigns, including occasional travel.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

description:
About the Role:

Reporting into the Brand Marketing Director, the Head of Social will be responsible for defining and driving TALA’s organic social strategy and growth agenda across our key social channels.

You will lead our social team, setting the strategic direction, identifying opportunities for growth and ensuring our social channels build brand awareness, cultural relevance, community and channel growth. You will balance creativity with data and commercial thinking, ensuring we are not just creating content, but building a social presence that drives the business forward.

You will work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, Influencer, PR, Product and Ecommerce teams, ensuring social is connected to the wider marketing strategy and that TALA continues to be ahead of the conversation.

We’re looking for a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable setting the direction, managing a team and getting into the details when needed.

Tasks

Day to day this looks like:

  • Social Strategy: Own and evolve TALA’s organic social strategy across Instagram and TikTok, with oversight of Pinterest and LinkedIn, setting clear objectives, channel roles, audiences, content pillars and KPIs.
  • Growth Strategy: Identify opportunities to grow TALA’s social audience, reach and relevance, developing strategies to increase awareness, engagement and community.
  • Planning & Prioritisation: Own the social planning process and ensure the calendar is driven by clear business, brand, product and customer priorities. Make clear recommendations on where the team should focus time, resources and investment.
  • Content Strategy: Set the strategic direction for the content we create, identifying the formats, stories, behaviours and cultural moments that will help TALA grow. Provide clear strategic direction and briefs to the content creators within the team, ensuring content is distinctive, relevant, engaging and effective against our KPIs.
  • Engineer Virality: Think beyond existing content formats to identify opportunities to create stop-and-look moments that capture attention and drive conversation. Challenge the team to think differently about how we execute ideas, finding unexpected, culturally relevant and creatively disruptive ways to make TALA stand out and content travel.
  • Trend & Culture: Stay ahead of social, cultural and platform trends, identifying opportunities for TALA to participate in the conversation in a way that feels authentic to the brand and has the potential to drive meaningful reach and growth.
  • Campaign Strategy: Partner with the Marketing team and Creative Director on campaign strategy, ensuring social plays a clear role in building awareness, excitement and cultural relevance. Develop channel strategies and rollout plans for key campaigns and launches.
  • Insights & Analytics: Own the analysis of social performance, customer behaviour and competitor activity. Turn data into clear insights and recommendations, using performance to continuously improve our strategy.
  • Test & Learn: Develop a test-and-learn approach across social, identifying new formats, platforms, creators and ways of working. Test, learn and scale what works.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, develop and inspire the social and content creation team, setting clear objectives, ways of working and standards. Ensure the team understands not just what they are creating, but why and what it needs to achieve.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce to ensure social is fully integrated into the wider marketing and commercial strategy.

  • Reporting: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting against social KPIs, going beyond performance reporting to provide clear insights, recommendations and actions for the wider business.
  • Key collaboration: Partner with the Head of Performance Marketing to create a boosting strategy
  • Social Innovation: Keep TALA ahead of how social is evolving, from new platforms and formats to creators, communities and emerging behaviours, ensuring we continue to find new ways to grow our audience.
  • Governance: Partner and align with the Creative Director on the visual representation of BAU, drops and campaign assets.

Requirements

You should:

  • Have significant professional social media experience, ideally within a fast-moving fashion, beauty, lifestyle or consumer brand.
  • Proven track record of working closely with a Creative team.
  • Be highly collaborative with key stakeholders including Brand, Creative, Performance, PR, Influencer, Product and Ecommerce.
  • Be able to demonstrate how you have grown a social presence, not just through content volume, but through a clear strategic approach.
  • Have a proven track record of developing and delivering social strategies that have driven audience and brand growth.
  • Have a deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok, with knowledge of Pinterest and LinkedIn.
  • Be highly analytical and commercially minded, able to interpret data and turn it into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Have a strong understanding of social culture, trends, formats and what makes content travel.
  • Have experience developing social strategies, content frameworks, channel plans and campaign rollouts.
  • Have experience managing and fostering development across a team, with the ability to set direction, inspire creativity and create a high-performing team culture.
  • Be an excellent cross-functional collaborator and communicator, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and multiple teams.
  • Be highly organised and an excellent project manager, able to bring clarity and structure to a fast-moving environment.
  • Be comfortable working in a start-up environment: working lean, moving quickly and finding solutions with available resources.
  • Be equally comfortable operating at a strategic level and getting into the detail when required.
  • Be driven, ambitious and solution-oriented, with a genuine passion for finding new opportunities for growth.
  • Have a strong understanding of the TALA brand and customer, and be excited about the opportunity to help shape the next stage of TALA’s growth.

  • Very generous employee discount after probation period

  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • Class Pass or Gym Flex membership

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

You'll help keep our open source and enterprise products trustworthy for the 6,000+ organizations that defend themselves with them.

This is not a solo audit role. As a Staff engineer, you advise the CISO on product security and turn their strategy into day-to-day practice in the product teams.   • Reports to: the CISO, as part of the Digital Security team.

  • Comfortable working with and leveraging AI-powered tools (LLMs, automation, copilots, etc.) to improve workflows and productivity

  • Master degreee in computer science and or cybersecurity with 8+ years of experience in software engineering and application or product security, including at least 3 years as the security technical reference for a SaaS or enterprise product

  • Comfortable working in a remote, async-first environment

  • Strong engineering and security skills: you write production code fluently in at least two of Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Rust, and you know web and API security in depth (GraphQL, OIDC/SAML, RBAC, multi-tenant isolation, SSRF, injection), CI/CD security tooling, and container and Kubernetes security

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

title: Lead AI engineer
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

title: Mid Market Sales Manager (Paris)
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time.

You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers.

You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

title: FTTH Security Expert
description:
About P1 Security

Founded in 2011 by serial entrepreneur and security expert Philippe Langlois, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities.

P1 Security is one of the very few companies in the world tackling telecom security through pure Mobile and Telecom Security attacks and security from 5G and Cloud-based infrastructure Security, OpenRAN, Network Slicing and RAN Sharing, Edge Computing (MEC), down to legacy 2/3/4G Diameter, SS7 SIGTRAN attacks, GTP manipulation and fuzzing.

Our offering and expertise range from Network and Telecom Core Network Security, Intrusion Detection and Vulnerability Assessment solutions, with technology backed by more than a decade of engineering research. We are a lean scale-up, engaged in emerging markets (Eastern Europe, Middle East, Asia), Europe and North America.

The P1 Security team includes experts from telecom operators and security companies as well as renowned security researchers who regularly present unique P1 Security research at leading international security conferences & GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, the R&D branch of P1 Security, shares Open Source initiatives with the telecom security community (www.github.com/P1sec/).

We are growing the team with people who want to help write it. We are looking for experienced profiles with grounded, hands-on knowledge of telecom networks — and a real appetite for FTTx technologies in particular. Curious, creative and open-minded people who want to dig deep into a genuinely sovereign topic: the security of the mobile networks our connectivity runs on.

Job Description

If your years have been spent in FTTx — access networks, PON, CPE, provisioning, field operations — and security has always been the question you kept coming back to, talk to us. The role described below does not really exist as a box to tick yet: we care far more about the person than about an exact match with a job title. Bring the part of the picture you know best, and we will build the rest together.

What you will do

  • Audits — you will plan and run scoped, authorized penetration tests of FTTH/PON infrastructure: OLTs, ONTs/ONUs, the management systems around the ODN, and customer premises equipment.

  • PON internals — you will dig into GPON, XG-PON, XGS-PON and NG-PON2: OMCI, PLOAM, and how ONTs are authenticated and provisioned.

  • CPE and gateways — you will take them apart: firmware extraction and reverse engineering, exposed debug interfaces (UART/JTAG), hardcoded credentials, update mechanisms and web/CLI management flaws.

  • Subscribers at scale — you will look at what provisions and manages them (TR-069/CWMP, TR-369/USP, ACS/OSS/BSS integrations, zero-touch provisioning) and at the subscriber-facing edge: BNG/BRAS, PPPoE/IPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, VLAN segmentation, QoS and isolation between subscribers.

  • Convergence and infrastructure — you will follow fixed–mobile convergence (5G FWA, shared core, shared OSS/BSS, unified identity and billing) and review devices and management planes (routers, switches, aggregation equipment, NMS/EMS, SNMP, NETCONF/YANG, SSH/Telnet, APIs, privileged access) against vendor and industry hardening baselines.

  • Threat modeling — you will map attack paths for real operator environments using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, the GSMA FASG/FS.xx guidance and the MITRE FiGHT knowledge base.

  • Findings and clients — you will turn all of this into clear, prioritized reports with proof-of-concept evidence, risk ratings and actionable remediation, present them to stakeholders, and support remediation verification and retesting.

  • The team — you will contribute to our internal tooling, test methodologies, lab environments and reusable attack playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge on Fixed-line network architecture (FTTx, DSL, Coaxial)

  • MANDATORY: Experience in security audit pentests on OT and IT infrastructure

  • Experience with vendor ecosystems such as Huawei, ZTE, Nokia, Ericsson, Calix, or Adtran FTTH equipment.

  • Familiarity with telecom security standards and frameworks: 3GPP SCAS, GSMA NESAS, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, and ITU-T/BBF specifications.

  • Experience in red teaming or adversary emulation against critical infrastructure.

  • Relevant certifications, such as:

  • OSCP / OSEP / OSWE / OSED

  • GPEN / GXPN / GRID

  • CEH (Practical), eJPT/eCPPT, or CRTO

  • Telecom-specific training (GSMA, Black Hat/DEF CON telecom or hardware trainings)

  • Published research, CVEs, conference talks, or bug bounty history in telecom or embedded devices.

If you have a passion for telecom security and want to be part of a dynamic and innovative team, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of Telecom Security!

Language requirements

  • English - fluent speaker

  • French - optional

Further details

  • 🏢 Headquarters: Fully remote company, with headquarters in Paris - FRANCE

  • 🏠 Remote policy:

  • At P1 Security, we recognize the importance of work-life balance, and that's why our remote policy is a key part of our company culture. We understand that flexibility is crucial, allowing our team members to work remotely while achieving their personal and professional goals. To keep our team connected, we schedule monthly meetups with department members and gather the entire team on-site every two months. These regular touch points ensure effective communication, collaboration, and a dynamic team spirit, reflecting the dynamic and adaptable spirit of P1 Security. We believe in the power of flexible work arrangements to bring out the best in our team, driving success in a way that suits everyone's unique lifestyle

Hiring process

  • First contact call (10-20min)

  • Direct manager call (30min)

  • Capability assessment exercice (depending on position)

  • C-level & Director call (30 min)

Specialisations

Telecommunications Security, SS7, SIGTRAN, LTE, IMS, UMTS, CDMA, GPRS, OpenStack, Kubernetes, LinuxServers / PNF, Diameter, NFV, Security, VoLTE, VoWifi, GTP, Diameter, 3G, 4G, IoT Security, NFV(i), S1AP, X2AP, Fuzzing, eUTRAN S1AP, X2AP, NgRAN, NGAP, PFCP, 5GC SBI

Contact

If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

title: Technicien / Ingénieur Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous
      • Un modèle de travail hybride : 3 jours par semaine sur site à Massy, 1 jour à Paris et 1 à 2 jours en télétravail
      • Une exposition quotidienne à l’ensemble de la stack quantique : des API haut niveau jusqu’au firmware bas niveau, et tout ce qui se trouve entre les deux

Processus de recrutement :

      • Entretien avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition (30 à 45 min)
      • Entretien avec le Hiring Manager (45 min)
      • Étude de cas : en direct ou à préparer chez vous puis à présenter
      • Rencontre avec les équipes
      • 2 prises de références
      • Offre

Ce processus est donné à titre indicatif et peut évoluer en fonction du poste.

Chez Quandela, nous sommes convaincus que la richesse de notre équipe repose sur la diversité des expériences, des perspectives et des parcours. Nous nous engageons à construire un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et accueillant. Toutes les candidatures sont les bienvenues.
